_about: What `krew-install.py --memory` / `--search` (both on by default in init) install, pinned (the User 2026-11-01: "EVERYthing we run is local ... we need to ship on installation as is all local"). Everything runs in user space under $KREW_HOME on loopback; nothing needs sudo or docker. Fetched once at install (each fetch checked against the number here); at run time the only outbound calls are the brain endpoint and SearXNG's own upstream engines. scripts/krew_install_memory.py and scripts/krew_install_search.py read this file only.

python._why: The reference install runs Hindsight on CPython 3.14.7. With uv, the venv asks for `want` (uv fetches it once); without uv, the first python3 on PATH at `min` or newer.

hindsight._why: hindsight-api 0.10.2 = the reference install (CLAUDE.md 'Hindsight is 0.10.1 ...', upgraded 10-02 by upgrade-0.10.2.sh). sqlalchemy<2.1: 2.1's bare postgresql:// is psycopg3 and hindsight migrates on psycopg2 (the four-night 15/15 rollback, docs/checkpoints/hindsight-fresh-20260928 on the reference install). torch comes from the CPU index first so a machine without a GPU never pulls the CUDA wheels (the reference venv is 6.5 GB with them).

plugin._why: The Hermes plugin is vendored (MIT, crew/hindsight/plugin/hindsight/LICENSE): installed from this copy, never fetched, so Hermes's catalog fetch and its scan never run. The copy is upstream's hindsight-integrations/hermes at `sha` minus its tests/ and its README banner image (krew ships text only) (byte-checked 2026-11-01 against the reference install's catalog copy: identical but the catalog stamp). tree_sha256 = sha256 over sorted 'path\0sha256(file)\n' of every file but LICENSE; install refuses a copy that does not match it.

vector_db._why: pg0-embedded (a hindsight-api dependency) carries PostgreSQL 18.1 with pgvector 0.8.5 in its own binary: proved 2026-11-01 with no network (bwrap --unshare-net): started, CREATE EXTENSION vector -> 0.8.5, 120 MB. Its own unit, so All OS Off/On and a Hindsight restart each touch only what they name.

embedding._why: ONE model on disk for krew's Hindsight and the Crissa kit's knowledge index (agreed with the kit's modules/knowledge 2026-11-01): the model the reference Hindsight runs. With the kit installed its lock (kit_lock) is read first; these values are the copy krew alone uses. Hindsight loads it with SentenceTransformers (allow); the kit reads the onnx export (onnx, sha-checked), fetched too so a later kit install finds everything offline.

searxng._why: SearXNG is AGPL-3.0: fetched at install from upstream at `commit` (a commit two weeks old on 2026-11-01), never vendored into krew (MIT). tarball_sha256 is GitHub's archive of that commit; tree_sha256 (sha256 over sorted 'path\0sha256(file)\n') is checked too, so a re-compressed archive with the same files still installs. Loopback only, limiter and image proxy off, json format on (Hermes's searxng provider asks for it).
